name: Caption FX (highlight-box, karaoke, marker, redact, scramble, blur-in, bounce-in)
retention: The word lighting up as it is said pulls the eye along the sentence; switching style per section (box, then marker on the claim) resets attention without a cut.
example: Cold brew that takes eighteen hours. Worth every minute.
credit: Caption styles adapted from Remocn (MIT) registry/remocn/caption-*@7aebcbe; modified (no Remotion code)
notes: It IS the captions for its span: hide the timeline's own captions there. Words come from the transcript (timeline seconds minus the clip start). marker needs `keywords` (else the longest word of each group). One clip can run the whole video; split it to change style per section.
